landing.lede: Places to visit, food, stays and deals — on one map, from the river to the Shwedagon.
landing.pillar1: Pagodas, tea shops, hotels, markets, hospitals and spas — sorted into seven simple groups.
landing.pillar2: Shops post their own discounts. Tap for directions and get a ticket to show at the counter.
landing.pillar3: One honest review per person for each place. Owners can reply, but they can never delete one.
landing.map1: Landmarks, food, stays and shops on a map drawn just for Yangon — with what is open right now.
landing.map2: Pick a group like Food & drink and the rest step back. Search by name, street or category.
landing.map3: Walk or take a taxi: the route draws itself on POINTER. Prefer Google Maps? One tap.
landing.catFood: Tea shops, mohinga stalls, cafés and restaurants — with what is open right now.
landing.catStay: Hotels and guesthouses, from colonial classics to simple rooms near the station.
landing.catVisit: Pagodas, parks, museums and the lakes — the Yangon everyone comes to see.
landing.catShop: Markets, malls and the small shops in between, from longyi to jade.
landing.catHealth: Hospitals, clinics and pharmacies, with opening hours and a call button.
landing.catBeauty: Spas and salons for a slow afternoon — thanaka included.
landing.catOther: Repairs, laundry, printing — the small services that keep the city running.
landing.rule1: One review per person for each place — you can edit it later.
landing.rule2: Owners can reply, but they can never delete a review.
landing.rule4: Save the places you love and find them again in My account.
landing.deal1: Every discount comes from the shop itself. Find them all on the Deals page — ending soon or newest first.
landing.deal2: The route opens on POINTER's map, and a ticket with the shop's code lands in My tickets. Your location is only used for the route.
landing.deal3: The owner checks that your code matches their post. The ticket works for two hours — no screenshots needed, no review asked for.
landing.own1: Send a request. Name, group, phone, opening hours, a pin on the map and one photo of your shop front, then pick 1, 3, 6 or 12 months and pay. No licence needed.
landing.own2: We check it. An admin compares your photo with the map pin and checks your payment, then approves it.
landing.own3: You're on the map. Post news and deals, reply to reviews and keep your hours up to date.
landing.whyText: POINTER is only useful when lots of people use it, and shops pay because those people are here. If users paid, fewer would come — and the app would be worth less to every shop.
landing.wheel3: 3Shops pay a small fee to be on the map, and the app keeps growing
landing.footNote: Ratings, reviews and deals are demo data
landing.plansLede: Users never pay. Shops pay for the time they are on the map, and get every owner tool from day one.
landing.plan1Fit: Try it out, or for a pop-up shop.
landing.plan3Fit: A season of deals for most shops.
landing.plan6Fit: Half a year of steady deals for a growing shop.
landing.plan12Fit: Set it once and forget it for a year.
landing.planF1: Your shop on the map and in search
landing.planF2: News and discount posts <small>(a short wait between posts)</small>
landing.planF4: Pin your best posts to the top
landing.planF5: Menu or services list with prices
landing.planF6: Call, Viber, Messenger and Telegram buttons
landing.planF8: Check customer tickets at the counter
landing.plansNote: Pay with KBZPay, Wave Pay or AYA Pay when you send your request (demo only in this project). We remind you 7 days before your plan ends; if it ends, your shop is hidden until you renew.
landing.flyLede: Every street and building of the city, with its landmarks modelled one by one — the same map you explore in the app.
